purpose: RO_WEB equipment/card/enchant/buff common fields, expanded against ROItemSearch enumvar/AddRandomOptionNameTable while rAthena Renewal remains formula authority.

timing.variableCastReductionRate: Additive percent reduction when CastTimeFlags permit item/status bonuses.
timing.fixedCastReductionRate: Strongest positive percent only, matching Renewal fixed-cast behavior.
timing.walkDelayAddMs: AfterCastWalkDelay penalty. Renewal default 300ms is resolved before modifiers.

offense.critAtkRate: Renewal bCritAtkRate: full on normal critical attacks, half on critical-enabled skills.
offense.crateFlat: Final C.RATE points; final critical multiplier is 1.4 + C.RATE/100.
offense.elementDamage: Map keyed by target armor element.
offense.ignoreDefRate: Hard DEF pierce percentage, capped at 100.
offense.ignoreMdefRate: Hard MDEF pierce percentage, capped at 100.
offense.ignoreResRate: RES pierce percentage, capped at 50 in the shared Renewal resolver.
offense.ignoreMresRate: MRES pierce percentage, capped at 50 in the shared Renewal resolver.
offense.criticalChanceByRace: Map keyed by target race; extra CRI/chance against that race only.
offense.ignoreDefByRace: Hard DEF pierce map keyed by target race.
offense.ignoreMdefByRace: Hard MDEF pierce map keyed by target race.
offense.ignoreResByRace: RES pierce map keyed by target race.
offense.ignoreMresByRace: MRES pierce map keyed by target race.
offense.ignoreDefByElement: Hard DEF pierce map keyed by target armor element.
offense.ignoreMdefByElement: Hard MDEF pierce map keyed by target armor element.
offense.ignoreDefByClass: Hard DEF pierce map keyed by Boss/NonBoss.
offense.ignoreMdefByClass: Hard MDEF pierce map keyed by Boss/NonBoss.
offense.ignoreWeaponSizePenalty: Non-zero removes the equipped weapon physical size penalty; accepted aliases weaponSizePerfect/perfectSizeDamage.

defense.criticalDefenseRate: Target critical damage reduction after the final C.RATE critical multiplier.
defense.classResist: Map keyed by attacker Boss/NonBoss class.
defense.physicalEnemyElementResist: Physical damage reduction keyed by the attacker own armor/property element.
defense.magicEnemyElementResist: Magic damage reduction keyed by the attacker own armor/property element.

healing.healPowerRate: Outgoing healing percentage; stacks with H.Plus.

notes: CastTimeFlags and CastDelayFlags are checked before item/card/status modifiers.
Fixed-cast percentage reductions do not add together; only the strongest reduction is used.
Cooldown and AfterCastActDelay are independent resources.
Skill-specific C++ exceptions remain explicit Runtime Profiles and are listed in the DX audit.
ROItemSearch enumvar.lua and AddRandomOptionNameTable.lua are used only to complete effect taxonomy/labels; rAthena Renewal remains the combat formula authority.
